description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'ReviewKpiAPI' within the OrangeHRM performance module. The class provides functionality to list KPIs associated with a specific performance review, including handling request parameters, validation rules, and response formatting. It uses traits for performance review services and user role management, and implements methods for fetching KPI data for a given review ID.
